A cashier at a corner shop received a counterfeit $50 bill and reported it to

suspect's iPhone was imaged first; a laptop seized at his house was imaged
afterwards. What began as a single forged note is expected to lead to an
organised counterfeiting operation.

| File | What it is |

  `tar tf` before extracting anything.
- The laptop image is read natively by The Sleuth Kit from the `.E01`; the
  segments must not be concatenated.

  answers can be recovered from the evidence.

Published forensic capture-the-flag, Belkasoft, April 5–7 2024.
Source: https://belkasoft.com/belkactf6/

## The incident

A cashier at a corner shop received a counterfeit $50 bill and reported it to
the police. With no other pressing cases, the investigation was assigned. The
suspect's iPhone was imaged first; a laptop seized at his house was imaged
afterwards. What began as a single forged note is expected to lead to an
organised counterfeiting operation.

this run read-only and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

# Case brief — BelkaCTF #6 "Bogus Bill"

Published forensic capture-the-flag, Belkasoft, April 5–7 2024.
Source: https://belkasoft.com/belkactf6/

## The incident

A cashier at a corner shop received a counterfeit $50 bill and reported it to
the police. With no other pressing cases, the investigation was assigned. The
suspect's iPhone was imaged first; a laptop seized at his house was imaged
afterwards. What began as a single forged note is expected to lead to an
organised counterfeiting operation.

## The evidence in this set

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `BelkaCTF_6_CASE240405_D201AP.tar` | 5.1 GB full file system acquisition of the suspect's iPhone (iOS), as a tar archive of the live file system |
| `BelkaCTF_6_CASE240405_LAPTOP.E01` … `.E06` | 8.7 GB EWF image of the suspect's Windows laptop, in six segments |

Both were published by Belkasoft as the CTF's evidence. They are handed to
this run read-only and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Notes

- The iPhone acquisition is a tar of a live iOS file system: application
  containers under `private/var/mobile/Containers/`, system data under
  `private/var/`, caches and preferences in the usual iOS places. List it with
  `tar tf` before extracting anything.
- The laptop image is read natively by The Sleuth Kit from the `.E01`; the
  segments must not be concatenated.
- The event's official write-up exists publicly. It is deliberately not part
  of this case and must not be consulted: the point of the run is whether the
  answers can be recovered from the evidence.

# Case brief — BelkaCTF #6 "Bogus Bill"

Published forensic capture-the-flag, Belkasoft, April 5–7 2024.
Source: https://belkasoft.com/belkactf6/

## The incident

A cashier at a corner shop received a counterfeit $50 bill and reported it to
the police. With no other pressing cases, the investigation was assigned. The
suspect's iPhone was imaged first; a laptop seized at his house was imaged
afterwards. What began as a single forged note is expected to lead to an
organised counterfeiting operation.

## The evidence in this set

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `BelkaCTF_6_CASE240405_D201AP.tar` | 5.1 GB full file system acquisition of the suspect's iPhone (iOS), as a tar archive of the live file system |

this run read-only and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

# Case brief — BelkaCTF #6 "Bogus Bill"

Published forensic capture-the-flag, Belkasoft, April 5–7 2024.
Source: https://belkasoft.com/belkactf6/

## The incident

A cashier at a corner shop received a counterfeit $50 bill and reported it to
the police. With no other pressing cases, the investigation was assigned. The
suspect's iPhone was imaged first; a laptop seized at his house was imaged
afterwards. What began as a single forged note is expected to lead to an
organised counterfeiting operation.

## The evidence in this set

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `BelkaCTF_6_CASE240405_D201AP.tar` | 5.1 GB full file system acquisition of the suspect's iPhone (iOS), as a tar archive of the live file system |
| `BelkaCTF_6_CASE240405_LAPTOP.E01` … `.E06` | 8.7 GB EWF image of the suspect's Windows laptop, in six segments |

Both were published by Belkasoft as the CTF's evidence. They are handed to
